token.title: Regenerate the connection token?
token.detail: AI clients that are connected or already set up will stop working and need to be configured again with the new command.

defaultApp.devNote: (Running in development mode, so the system does not recognise this executable. Set it up on the packaged app.)

mac.message: Set the default Markdown app in Finder
mac.detail:
macOS does not let an app change the default itself. Please follow these steps:

1. Select any .md file in Finder
2. Press ⌘I to open Get Info
3. Under “Open with”, choose “{{name}}”
4. Click “Change All…” and confirm{{devNote}}

win.message: Set the default Markdown app in Windows
win.detail:
Windows does not let an app change the default itself. Please follow these steps:

1. Click the button below to open the Default apps settings
2. Search for .md
3. Choose “{{name}}”{{devNote}}

other.detail: In your file manager, right-click any .md file → Properties → Open with → choose “{{name}}” and set it as the default.{{devNote}}

ai.intro: Let an AI assistant (such as Claude Code) read and edit your documents through MCP. The server only listens on this computer.
ai.allowWriteHint: When off, the AI can only read.
ai.directWriteHint: Skips the line-by-line review: changes the AI makes are applied at once instead of being shown as a diff. Only takes effect while “Allow AI to edit documents” is on.
